response.original_title: Bios, Vidas que marcaron la tuya: Charly García
response.overview: BIOS reveals unsuspected details of the life and work of Latin American popular culture icons.  Renowned personalities enter the intimacy of the protagonists and, thanks to an exclusive access, they witness unforgettable and unique moments, while discovering first-hand unpublished archives of their past.  In this first chapter, the singer and composer Julieta Venegas accepts the challenge of entering the universe of her idol and reference, Charly García. Together they revisit the first stage of his career as a musician, starting from the formation of Sui Generis to the separation of Serú Girán then "La Maquina de hacer pajaros" till the birth of his solo career with the album "Yendo de la cama al living" and his consecration with Clics Modernos, perhaps his work summit.
response.tagline: Bios: Vidas que marcaron la tuya
